close_reason:
Four sites updated to use ClientError::Parse instead of ClientError::InvalidArgument(e.to_string()):
- blob.rs:207 (Blob/convert request building - to_value)
- ws.rs:120 (send_stream_enable - to_string)
- ws.rs:128 (send_stream_disable construct-via-deserialize from literal - from_str)
- ws.rs:131 (send_stream_disable - to_string)

Rationale: these are internal-invariant serialization failures on locally-built typed structs / hardcoded literals, not caller-supplied input. ClientError::InvalidArgument is semantically wrong for them. ClientError::Parse(serde_json::Error) preserves the structured error and matches the existing convention used at chat.rs:60 and base-client.

API break is acceptable per pre-1.0 status — any caller pattern-matching on InvalidArgument to detect these specific failures (unlikely given opaque error messages) must update to Parse.

Comment added on the ws.rs sites explaining why these are internal-invariant bugs not caller input.

cargo test green, clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean, fmt clean. Committed as 991835b.
description: Three sites discard structured serde_json::Error and wrap as InvalidArgument(String): blob.rs:204 ('.map_err(|e| ClientError::InvalidArgument(e.to_string()))' on serde_json::to_value), ws.rs:120 (serde_json::to_string in send_stream_enable), ws.rs:128 (serde_json::from_str in send_stream_disable), ws.rs:131 (another serde_json::to_string). ClientError already has a typed Parse(serde_json::Error) variant (used in chat.rs etc.) and should have a typed Serialize/encoding variant if not present. Engineering basis: callers cannot match on the underlying serde error type — they get a String. Loss of structured error info is exactly the 'Error variants that wrap String for the message instead of structured fields' anti-pattern from the Rust review guide. ws.rs:128 also conflates a deserialization failure with InvalidArgument, which is semantically wrong: a serialize-only-path string failing to deserialize is an internal-invariant bug, not caller-supplied input.
title: Several serde_json::Error sites lose structure via 'e.to_string()' into InvalidArgument
